# R3M Tech

> Delivering software development solutions since 2012. Specializing in AI, Elixir, Phoenix, Kotlin, Java, and JS.

## About

R3M Tech is a Brazilian software development company founded in 2012 by Raul Pereira (https://raulpe7eira.tech/), providing software engineering services with a focus on AI, Elixir, and Phoenix.
